details:
Currently we can only view key binding but we can't edit it.

Let’s set aside the fact that users want to customize their key bindings for now.

As games add more and more key bindings, they’ll end up conflicting with the key bindings in the worlds. We have no way to resolve this other than waiting for the world creators to modify the key bindings.

(For example, the new HUD introduced in this update uses the F4 key, which causes issues in some flight worlds.)

There are many canny COMPLAIN about this problem and they got NO response.

This problem will just become more serious in the future. (See above)

Some post i found about this problem:

- Why you should add custom key binding and how: https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/keybinds-for-desktop-mode

- Somebody keyboard don't have end key, oops: https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/change-desktop-afk-key

- Another request for custom key binding: https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/bindings-for-pc

- Yet another request with more use case: https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/allow-us-to-assign-our-own-bindings-to-vrchat
title: Allow change key bindings for desktop mode
